name: fiscal402
description: Open protocol specification and verification tooling for verifiable fiscal events in autonomous commerce.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/check-public-contract.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@fiscal402/verify && npm run build --workspace=@fiscal402/sdk && npm run build --workspace=@fiscal402/node && npm run build --workspace=@fiscal402/cli
scripts.conformance: npm run build --workspace=@fiscal402/verify && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/verify/test/conformance.test.ts packages/verify/test/verify.test.ts packages/verify/test/verify-v2.test.ts
